title: Web APIs
definition: A specific type of API that can be accessed over the internet using the HTTP protocol.
simpleExplanation: When most people say 'API', they actually mean 'Web API'. It is an interface that lives on a server somewhere in the world. You talk to it by sending web requests (just like typing a URL in Chrome), and it talks back by sending raw data (usually JSON) instead of HTML webpages.
realWorldExample: The Spotify Web API. You send an HTTP request over the internet to `api.spotify.com/v1/tracks/123`, and Spotify's servers send back a JSON text file containing the song name, artist, and album cover URL.

basic: What protocol do almost all Web APIs use to communicate over the internet?
intermediate: If a Web API does not return HTML, what data format does it usually return?

answers.question: What format?
answers.answer: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation). It is lightweight, readable by humans, and easily parsed by any programming language.
